<h1 id="归并排序力扣题leetcode">归并排序力扣题（leetcode）</h1>
<h2 id="23-合并-k-个升序链表"><a href="https://leetcode.cn/problems/merge-k-sorted-lists/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">23. 合并 K 个升序链表</a></h2>
<p>难度：困难</p>
<p>相关标签：<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/linked-list/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">链表</a>、<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/divide-and-conquer/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">分治</a>、<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/heap-priority-queue/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">堆（优先队列）</a>、<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/merge-sort/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">归并排序</a></p>
<h3 id="题目">题目：</h3>
<p>给你一个链表数组，每个链表都已经按升序排列。</p>
<p>请你将所有链表合并到一个升序链表中，返回合并后的链表。</p>
<p><strong>示例 1:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">输入：lists = [[1,4,5],[1,3,4],[2,6]]
输出：[1,1,2,3,4,4,5,6]
解释：链表数组如下：
[
  1-&gt;4-&gt;5,
  1-&gt;3-&gt;4,
  2-&gt;6
]
将它们合并到一个有序链表中得到。
1-&gt;1-&gt;2-&gt;3-&gt;4-&gt;4-&gt;5-&gt;6
</code></pre>
<p><strong>示例 2:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">输入：lists = []
输出：[]
</code></pre>
<p><strong>示例 3:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">输入：lists = [[]]
输出：[]
</code></pre>
<p><strong>提示：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(k == lists.length\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(0 &lt;= k &lt;= 10^4\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(0 &lt;= lists[i].length &lt;= 500\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(-10^4 &lt;= lists[i][j] &lt;= 10^4\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(lists[i]\)</span>按 <strong>升序</strong> 排列</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(lists[i].length\)</span> 的总和不超过 10<sup>4</sup></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="代码">代码：</h3>
<pre><code class="language-C++">/**
 * Definition for singly-linked list.
 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;
 *     ListNode *next;
 *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution 
{
public:
    ListNode* mergeList(ListNode* left, ListNode* right)
    {
        // 虚拟头节点
        ListNode* newNodePtr = new ListNode(-1);
        ListNode* curPtr = newNodePtr;

        // 双指针归并（和数组归并逻辑完全一致）
        while(left != nullptr &amp;&amp; right != nullptr)
        {
            if(left-&gt;val &lt;= right-&gt;val)  
            {
                curPtr-&gt;next = left;
                left = left-&gt;next;
            }
            else 
            {
                curPtr-&gt;next = right;
                right = right-&gt;next;
            }
            curPtr = curPtr-&gt;next;
        }

        if(left != nullptr)  curPtr-&gt;next = left;
        if(right != nullptr)  curPtr-&gt;next = right;

        // 返回排序后的链表头
        return newNodePtr-&gt;next;
    }

    // 分治归并
    ListNode* merge(vector&lt;ListNode*&gt;&amp; lists, int l, int r)
    {
        if(l == r)  return lists[l];
        if(l &gt; r)  return nullptr;
        int mid = (l+r)/2;
        ListNode* left = merge(lists, l, mid);
        ListNode* right = merge(lists, mid+1, r);
        return mergeList(left, right);
    }

    // 主函数入口
    ListNode* mergeKLists(vector&lt;ListNode*&gt;&amp; lists) 
    {
        if(lists.empty())  return nullptr;
        return merge(lists, 0, lists.size()-1);
    }
};
</code></pre>
<h3 id="相似题目">相似题目</h3>
<p><a href="https://leetcode.cn/problems/merge-two-sorted-lists/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">合并两个有序链表</a>简单</p>
<p><a href="https://leetcode.cn/problems/ugly-number-ii/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">丑数 II</a>中等</p>
<p><a href="https://leetcode.cn/problems/smallest-subarrays-with-maximum-bitwise-or/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">按位或最大的最小子数组长度</a>中等</p>
<h2 id="148-排序链表"><a href="https://leetcode.cn/problems/sort-list/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">148. 排序链表</a></h2>
<p>难度：中等</p>
<p>相关标签：<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/linked-list/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">链表</a>、<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/two-pointers/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">双指针</a>、<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/divide-and-conquer/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">分治</a>、<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/sorting/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">排序</a>、<a href="https://leetcode.cn/tag/merge-sort/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">归并排序</a></p>
<h3 id="题目-1">题目：</h3>
<p>给你链表的头结点 <code>head</code> ，请将其按 <strong>升序</strong> 排列并返回 <strong>排序后的链表</strong> 。</p>
<p><strong>示例 1:</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2657127/202603/2657127-20260325172712925-394468935.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">输入：head = [4,2,1,3]
输出：[1,2,3,4]
</code></pre>
<p><strong>示例 2:</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2657127/202603/2657127-20260325172711700-2020229035.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">输入：head = [-1,5,3,4,0]
输出：[-1,0,3,4,5]
</code></pre>
<p><strong>示例 3:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">输入：head = []
输出：[]
</code></pre>
<p><strong>提示：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>链表中节点的数目在范围 $[0, 5 * 10^4] $内</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(-10^5 &lt;= Node.val &lt;= 10^5\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>进阶：</strong>你可以在 <span class="math inline">\(O(n log n)\)</span> 时间复杂度和常数级空间复杂度下，对链表进行排序吗？</p>
<h3 id="代码-1">代码：</h3>
<pre><code class="language-C++">/**
 * Definition for singly-linked list.
 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;
 *     ListNode *next;
 *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution
 {
public:
    int tmp[100010];  // 足够大
    void merge_sort(int q[], int l, int r) 
    {
        if (l &gt;= r)  return;
        int mid = l + r &gt;&gt; 1;

        merge_sort(q, l, mid);
        merge_sort(q, mid + 1, r);

        int i = l, j = mid + 1, k = 0;
        while (i &lt;= mid &amp;&amp; j &lt;= r) 
        {
            if (q[i] &lt;= q[j])  tmp[k++] = q[i++];
            else  tmp[k++] = q[j++];
        }

        while (i &lt;= mid)  tmp[k++] = q[i++];
        while (j &lt;= r)  tmp[k++] = q[j++];

        for (i = l, j = 0; i &lt;= r; i++, j++)  q[i] = tmp[j];
    }

    // 主函数：链表排序
    ListNode* sortList(ListNode* head) 
    {
        // 1. 把链表节点搬移到数组中
        vector&lt;int&gt; arr;
        ListNode* p = head;
        while (p != nullptr) 
        {
            arr.push_back(p-&gt;val);
            p = p-&gt;next;
        }

        int n = arr.size();
        if (n == 0) return nullptr;

        // 2. 直接用你写的归并排序排序数组
        merge_sort(&amp;arr[0], 0, n - 1);

        // 3. 把排序后的数组重新搬回链表
        ListNode* newNodePtr = new ListNode(-1);
        ListNode* curPtr = newNodePtr;
        for (int x : arr) 
        {
            curPtr-&gt;next = new ListNode(x);
            curPtr = curPtr-&gt;next;
        }

        return newNodePtr-&gt;next;
    }
};
</code></pre>
